decisions.reason: The firm has invested in and maintained the door lever handle family on its website since 2018, and escalation of commitment makes dropping it unlikely despite any quiet periods.
Continued presence on the website reflects sunk costs and responsibility, so management persists with the door handle design under escalation of commitment.
The electronic access system has high public visibility and central strategic importance with its unique light technology, so the firm is strongly committed and unlikely to drop it.
